snippet.title: Flex City Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the new island - Flex City!

Flex City offers an open-world sandbox-like game experience where players can hang out with their friends without the pressure of hard competition. Explore 60-players city playground filled with a wide assortment of luxury cars, boats, aircrafts, and dozens of fun activities.

Follow your favorite way of life in Flex City. And, of course, invite your friends to play with you!
Follow us on social media to keep up with all Flex City news!


🎮 PLAY FLEX CITY:
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jarvigames.viceonline
